content: Never use floats for money in JS (0.1+0.2 !== 0.3). Store integer minor units (centavos). Dinero.js v2 (2.0.2) is the most complete option: immutable, stores amount as integer + scale, supports allocate() to split an amount across ratios while fairly distributing the rounding remainder to the largest share -- directly applicable to splitting a purchase into N credit-card installments. currency.js is a smaller (1KB) alternative without allocate's fairness guarantees.
